text:
Jordan, Kathrin thanks guys 😅
I wouldn't say I'm the most knowledgeable immigration lawyer in all of Israel (there's always more to learn) but probably one of them when it comes to the partner visa process and its bureaucracy. 
It's especially funny because many times the lawyers mentioned in this group are contacting me personally when their clients ask them questions they're unsure about. 

Kat, I think maybe your lawyer submitted an application for you online and you're unaware. Appointments at the office are definitely a part of the process but that does not contradict the online application. Maybe you should do more research 😉
